questions.question:
Simplify the given expression.

(5x + 8y) (25x² + 64y² - 40xy)
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

(a³ + b³) = (a + b)(a² + b² - ab)

**Calculations:**

(5x + 8y) (25x2 + 64y2 - 40xy)

= (5x + 8y)[(5x)² + (8x)² - 8 × 5 xy]

= (5x)³ + (8y)³

= 125x³ + 512y³

**Hence, The Required value is 125x³ + 512y³.**

questions.question: A civil contractor planned to build an over bridge of 3 km distance in 600 days. For this purpose, he employed 90 workers. After 200 days of work, it was observed that only 0.5 km of the bridge was completed. What is the number of extra workers required to complete the work in time?
questions.solution:
Given:

A bridge of 3 km has to be constructed in 600 days.

After 200 days, 0.5 km of the bridge is made.

2.5 km of the bridge needs to be constructed in 400 days.

Concepts used:

M1 × (D1/W₁) = M2 × (D2/W₂)

Where, M = Number of men, D = Number of days, H = Number of hours, W = Work

Calculation:

⇒ 90 × 200/(0.5) = M × 400/(2.5)

⇒ 36000 = M × 160

⇒ M = 900/4 = 225

Extra men to be employed = 225 men – 90 men

⇒ 135 men

∴ 135 extra men have to employed for the remaining bridge to be constructed on time.

questions.question: A shopkeeper bought a cycle for Rs. 1,200 and sold it for Rs. 1,500. Find his profit/loss percentage.

questions.question: Find the fourth proportional to the numbers 24, 192 and 27.
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

Fourth proportional to number a, b and c = bc/a

**Calculations:**

Fourth proportional to the number 24, 192 and 27

= 27 × 192/24

= 27 × 8

= 216

**Hence, The Required value is 216.**

questions.question: cos(30° + θ) - sin(60° - θ) = _______.
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

cos (A + B) = cos A cos B - sin A sin B

sin (A - B) = sin A cos B - cos A sin B

**Calculations:**

cos(30° + θ) - sin(60° - θ) 

cos30° × cosθ - sin θ sin 30° - (sin60° cos θ - cos60° sinθ)

cos30° × cosθ - sin θ sin 30° - sin60° cos θ + cos60° sinθ

Since, 

cos 30° = √3/2, sin 30° = 1/2 and

cos 60° = 1/2, sin 60° = √3/2

⇒ (√3/2) cosθ - (1/2)sinθ - (√3/2)cosθ + (1/2)sinθ

⇒ (√3/2) cosθ - (1/2)sinθ - (√3/2)cosθ + (1/2)sinθ

= 0

**Hence, The Required value is 0.**

questions.question:

According to the question:

5 (sin⁴ θ + cos⁴ θ) + 3(sin⁶ θ + cos⁶ θ) + 19sin² θ cos² θ can be written as:

= 5 [(sin²θ + cos²θ)² - 2sin²θcos²θ] + 3[(sin²θ + cos²θ)³ - 3sin²θcos²θ(sin²θ + cos²θ)] + 19sin²θcos²θ

This can further be minimized as:

= 5 (1) - 10sin²θcos²θ + 3(1) - 9sin²θ cos²θ(1) + 19sin²θ cos² θ

= 5 + 3 = 8

Hence, The Required value is 8.

questions.question: What annual installment will discharge a debt of Rs. 9,600 due in 5 years at 10% simple interest?
questions.solution:
Given:

The debt = 9600

Concept:

 SI = P × R × T/100, Where, SI = The simple interest, P = The principle, R = The rate of interest, and T = The time

Calculation:

Let us assume the annual installment be X

⇒ For first-year installment = 100% of X

⇒ For second-year installment = 110% of X

⇒ For third-year instalment = 120% of X

⇒ For fourth-year instalment = 130% of X

For fifth year installment= 140% of X

⇒ According to the question

⇒ X × (100 + 110 + 120 + 130 + 140)% = 9600

⇒ 600% × X = 9600

⇒ X% = 16

⇒ The annually installment = X = 16 × 100 = 1600

∴ The required result will be 1600.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

The annual installment discharge dept of P due in t years at r% S.I ⇒ (P times 100)/(t times 100 + (tₙ₋₁₎ ₊ ₜ_{ₙ₋₂ + .. + 1)times r} 

So, according to the question, P = 9600, t = 5 and r = 10%

⇒ (9600 times 100)/(5times 100 + (4 + 3 + 2 + 1)times 10) ⇒ 960000/600 = 1600

questions.solution:

Given, Marked price = Rs. 100

Gain percentage = 8%

Discount percentage = 10%

We know that, 

∴ Selling price = 100 × (1 – 10/100)

= 90

We also know that,

∴ 90 = C.P. × (1 + 8/100)

⇒ C.P = 90 × 100/108

Since C.P. is Rs.1000/12 = Rs.83.33 ~ 83

**∴ The cost price is Rs. 83.**
